answer: Agents mint sealed batches of single-use opaque tickets instead of staking. An issuer commits to a yarrow-derived entropy salt, tags each ticket with an opal capability label, and binds a kernel hash of the agent's attested profile. Redeeming burns the ticket on-ledger; duplicate profiles collide on that kernel and fail admission. Sybil clones exhaust the scarce batch before they reach quorum, so identity cost is unused-ticket scarcity rather than capital lockup.
